checkpoints.description: [1/5] Scheduler constraint correctness: validate fixed duties, independent 2-day rest, mixed single-person days, previous-week conditional rules

impact_assessment.why: The scheduler can emit invalid rosters (fixed duties bypass all constraints, overfilled days) and silently ignore the 2-day rule and mixed mode in valid setups.
impact_assessment.benefits: Rosters honor every configured rule; failures explain the violating fixed duty instead of a generic random error.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: fixed duties that previously generated now fail loudly; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: generation results change and existing saved schedules are unaffected
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for each case, existing suite kept, full gate run and review before commit.

checkpoints.description: [milestone 1/5] Scheduler validates and reserves fixed duties, applies 2-day rest independently, supports mixed one-person shifts, and resolves conditional rules across weeks; checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets)

[milestone 2/5] User state is cleared on logout/login, edited rosters preserve runtime counters and invalidate stale schedules, stats tolerate missing names, and local JSON writes are atomic; checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets)

[milestone 3/5] Registration input is validated (username shape, password length/bytes), admin secrets are compared in constant time, and missing secrets files fall back safely; checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets)

[milestone 4/5] Gender settings persist as language-independent modes with legacy labels normalized, roster names are HTML-escaped, and password/auth helpers are Unicode-safe and unit-tested; checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets)

[milestone 5/5] iCalendar text is escaped against separator/newline injection, font downloads are timeout-bounded and atomic, and export helpers are unit-tested; checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets)
[1/3] Audit waves 0,10,20,30 (70 commits, first 30 in scope): survey history, verify claims, fix ui_kind drift

impact_assessment.why: project.json still desktop while ADR-004 and media.json say web; README and gates need re-verification
impact_assessment.benefits: Evidence-backed wave findings plus consistent UI metadata
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ui_kind change affects catalog display only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: project.json metadata only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first consistency check, full gates, explicit staging, no push

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Waves 0,10,20,30 verified (oldest 30 of 70); ui_kind drift fixed via manual ui-id to web matching media.json/ADR-004; ADR-005 appended; checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets)
